$comment: How upstream KeePassXC-Browser paths and names map onto this fork. scripts/extension-sync.mjs applies it after a `git subtree pull` (docs/browser-extension.md, Syncing with upstream). `paths` are moved with `git mv`, in order, relative to extension/; a `*` matches within one file name and is carried into `to`. `text` rules are literal strings rewritten in the files `textFiles` match, minus `textExclude`; a rule with `regex: true` is a JavaScript regular expression. Internal JS identifiers (kpxc*, keepass.*, kpxcEvent) and protocol strings are deliberately not renamed.

text.$comment: The source folder in paths and globs ('keepassxc-browser', ../keepassxc-browser/, keepassxc-browser/**), but not in URLs (keepassxreboot/keepassxc-browser, addon/keepassxc-browser/).
